unverified.evidence: the verified contract rule (metadataId = ((id - 1 + startingIndex) % maxSupply) + 1) fits all 50 token/name pairs read from OpenSea only for 1461
unverified.howToClose: node tools/nft/read-chain.ts (reads startingIndex, and with --all checks metadataId for all 1,969 tokens)

unverified.evidence: OpenSea reports tokenUri .../ipfs/<this CID>/1246.json for token 1754, and the contract builds tokenURI as baseURI + metadataId + ".json"

unverified.claim: the 1,969 files in data/chog-genesis/raw are exactly what the CID names
unverified.evidence: fetched as one CAR through a text-only scraping service from OpenSea's gateway; all 1,969 parse, the directory lists exactly 1.json to 1969.json, file 1246.json is identical on two gateways, 12 of 12 trait counts match OpenSea
unverified.notEvidence: blocks were not hashed against their content ids (the transport turned bytes into text), and each object was assigned to its file number by the number in its own name and image URI, not by the directory entry that points at it (those entries are binary)
unverified.howToClose: node tools/nft/verify-ipfs.ts (hashes every block, compares every file)

unverified.evidence: mint.chog.xyz shows "Minted 1,969 / 1,969" and says phase counts are read from the contract; OpenSea lists 1,969 items

unverified.claim: this contract is the official CHOG Genesis contract
unverified.evidence: official mint site mint.chog.xyz links to the OpenSea collection chog-genesis, whose items use this address; the source is verified on Sourcify as ChogMint (exact match, 2026-09-03); supply and metadata description (1969 pieces) agree
unverified.notEvidence: no ChogLabs page found that prints the address; the official site renders it with JavaScript this project could not run
unverified.howToClose: owner or ChogLabs confirms the address in an official channel

unverified.claim: every minted token is accounted for by the published mint phases
unverified.evidence: mint site phases: GTD 1,206, FCFS Chest 350, FCFS Roles 157, FCFS 0, Public 0 = 1,713 of 1,969
unverified.notEvidence: 256 tokens are not explained by the phase list (probably the reserve / team mint, which the contract supports)
unverified.howToClose: read reserveMinted() and the Minted events

unverified.evidence: ownerOf(uint256) is in the verified ABI
unverified.notEvidence: no owner was read; ownership changes and is not catalogue data
unverified.howToClose: at bind time, server side, with ownerOf (design in docs/design/nft.md)

unverified.claim: what the game may do with the artwork
unverified.evidence: no collection-specific terms were found (only general articles on NFT licensing)
unverified.notEvidence: the contract source is MIT licensed; that is the code, not the art
unverified.howToClose: owner asks ChogLabs for written terms; until then use no Chog art in the build

unverified.claim: image files exist and match their names
unverified.evidence: image URIs follow ipfs://<image CID>/<n>.webp for all 1,969 records
unverified.notEvidence: no image was downloaded or looked at, so every visual statement in the docs comes from trait names only
unverified.howToClose: download from the image CID and view a sample

unverified.claim: OpenSea rarity rank for all tokens
unverified.evidence: 50 ranks read from one listing page, all reproduced exactly by calculated score M5; OpenSea says its ranking follows OpenRarity with Double Sort and Trait Count updates
unverified.notEvidence: the ranks of the other 1,919 tokens were not read and OpenSea's full formula is not published
unverified.howToClose: not needed for the game; the OpenSea API with a key would list every rank
